source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In advanced or metastatic MPNST, the response rate to doxorubicin plus ifosfamide is about 21% in a multi-institutional retrospective study.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 20 Kroep 2011 PMID 20656792. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.The cited EORTC study compared MPNST with other soft-tissue sarcoma subtypes; not NF1-specific.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 20
